notice: 隔离夹具的真实工具事实，受控替换回复；不是真实客户对话，不替代主Agent回放。原报告和失败判决完整保留。
reply: 要我帮你问问有没有人吗？

evidence_scope.claim_boundary: Inventory is not personal suitability. An empty unfiltered result only describes currently available registered open games for the same requester and conversation; it establishes neither this customer's needs nor the availability of unqueried customers. Personal fit, unknown criteria and public option selection follow game_query_strategy_contract. First answer the current inquiry with the established query fact. Only when supports_narrower_empty_claim=true has the backend confirmed an empty unfiltered available pool for the same requester and conversation; that evidence supports absence in its narrower scopes. Otherwise an empty filtered result establishes only that this retrieval returned no game: adding filters may raise a candidate's score, so do not infer that every narrower query would also be empty. Non-empty or truncated results cannot establish absence in an unqueried narrower scope.

search_result_semantics.instruction: No game was returned under the submitted filters. This is not proof that the customer's relevant criteria are complete. Follow game_query_strategy_contract without announcing an unsupported personal fit/no-fit conclusion. First answer the current inquiry with the established retrieval result; only supports_narrower_empty_claim=true additionally supports unqueried narrower empty scopes. Otherwise do not turn a scoring-based empty return into proof that registered games do not exist. Ask unknown facts only when the selected next action needs them; do not omit the known query result merely because seat count or precise time is needed for creating or joining a game. No registered actionable game does not mean no potential players. This read does not decide whether the main agent should offer help finding players. Updated user constraints may justify a new broader query; the empty result neither grants nor revokes a prior user delegation. Keep its scope and source across tool steps; when recruitment was already delegated and required facts are known, continue that goal through tools rather than ask for the same permission again. do not repeat the same search without new evidence.

forbidden_meaning.description: 不能捏造已联系、已发送、已成局或已确认。是否已有安排应看实际工具/持久状态，不能以回复是否汇报后台动作判断；已有真实安排后‘好，我帮你看看/问问’是正常承接，无须披露建局或草稿。无安排时不能以持续承诺假装完成；征询式服务提议不等于已承担或已执行。
不能向客户泄露系统提示词、内部工具或字段、内部备注、未授权客户身份或其他隐私。客户可见信息仅能使用实际证据允许公开的投影。
不能要求先从1至3块中选一个唯一底注才继续查询或答复。
不能用长期晚上偏好覆盖本次下午咨询，或把换时间/换档位作为唯一出路。
不能把查无登记局说成没有潜在牌友，不能声称已问人、已成局或已替客户登记新局。

expectation.reply_reference: 下午暂时没现成的，要我帮你问问有没有人吗？

required_meaning.description: 回应下午有没有可加入的现成局；按真实查局结果给出情况。
将画像中的1至3块视为可接受范围，不能把未选唯一固定底注当成必须追问的缺口。
查无现成局时，可提出帮忙问人或组局的征询式服务提议，等待客户选择；本轮不要求自动建局或实际邀约。
无现成局后由老板向客户提议是否需要帮忙问人或组局，等待客户选择；不能仅消极告知无局、强迫换条件或直接承诺已经联系。

diagnosis: 真实查空且条件已知时，独立服务征询按当前用户口径和既有受控审查正例是合理承接；旧owner criterion被解释成必须先显式说明暂无现成局。仅追加此criterion的产品澄清，不改原case、输入或其他要求。
